VoxWeave Portable
=================

Run voxweave.exe from a user-writable folder. Keep voxweave.portable beside it.
VoxWeave stores settings, downloaded models, and logs in data/ beside the executable.
This folder can contain API keys and diagnostic text; keep it private. Models may be large.

WebView2 is required. Launch at login is unavailable in portable mode. Disable launch at
login in an installed copy before converting or moving that copy.
